messages:
Alex: Quick prototype pushed — added an 'uncertainty band' behind the line series (semi-transparent) to surface variance without extra legend clutter. Looks a lot cleaner than tiny error bars.
Maya: can you drop a screenshot here? :eyes:
Alex: attached in staging (not in this export). Quick notes: when smoothing=on the band balloons on low-sample series and looks noisy.
Sam: Do we want the band to represent rolling std or a CI? Rolling std is cheaper and easier to explain.
Riley: rolling std + show dashed outline when sample_count < 5 so users know it's low-confidence.
Maya: UX nit — legend needs to explain the band. Suggest label: 'mean ± std (window=7)'. Also small question: where do we surface the window size toggle?
Jordi: Units problem: axis switches to 'K' for >1000 which confuses rate charts (requests/sec). Proposal: add per-chart unit control in the legend header: [units: auto | raw | per-s]. Defaults to auto.
Alex: +1 on explicit unit control. Implementation note: persist preference per-user in localStorage or profile.
Sam: Outlier policy idea: clip display range at 99.5th percentile and render clipped points with a chevron marker and tooltip saying 'value clipped — click to expand'. Avoid automatic log-scale toggles which surprise people.
Maya: accessibility: clipped markers must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-labels. Legend items should be in tab order and Enter toggles series visibility.
Riley: Tooltip copy suggestion: 'Value exceeds display range and is clipped to improve readability. Press Enter or click to expand the full value.'
Jordi: Quick CSS I tried locally to illustrate the band + clipped marker: \n```\n.line--uncertainty { fill: rgba(30,120,180,0.12); stroke: none; }\n.point--clipped::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 6px solid transparent; border-right: 6px solid transparent; border-top: 6px solid #d9534f; }\n```\nAlex: Another small UX: when smoothing is enabled, show a tiny badge in the legend 'smoothed' and hover to show algorithm + window size.
Maya: Could we auto-disable smoothing for series with fewer than 10 points? artefacts are pretty bad otherwise.
Sam: Plan from eng side: 1) update legend copy and add 'smoothed' badge docs, 2) add per-chart unit control and persist, 3) implement clip policy + marker + tooltip, 4) a11y: ensure legend tab order + aria-labels, 5) provide CSS tokens for band and clipped marker. I'll draft spec and small API for chart options.
Maya: assign to Sam for spec, Alex for prototype work. :thumbsup:
VizBot: Deploy preview available: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/ux-2365 — snapshot id ux-2365
Alex: Thanks — will iterate on band opacity and the dashed outline threshold.
Maya: leaving comments on the spec doc now.
Sam: I'll open a follow-up PR with the clip marker + aria attributes next week.
Riley: one more tiny thing — keyboard users should be warned when a series is clipped via a live region announcement 'Series X clipped at 99.5th percentile' so screen readers hear it.
Maya: good catch. Add to spec.
Alex: OK merging notes into design doc. Thanks everyone.
